articles.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
articles.snippet: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

articles.title: Cysic dangles a 10% bounty, hacker pours loot into Tornado Cash
articles.snippet: The attacker moved $744,000 in ETH and BNB to Tornado Cash after exploiting Cysic’s bridge to mint 10 million tokens on BNB Smart Chain.

articles.title: What Is a Bitcoin-Backed Loan? Borrowing Against BTC Explained
articles.snippet: Bitcoin-backed loans let holders borrow cash or stablecoins without selling BTC. Here's how collateral, LTV and liquidations work.
